facts.value: Resolves the Item, clears xC9C, and unconditionally calls it_8027B798 to fill a stack-local Vec3, ignoring its boolean result. That helper derives the vector from knockback, hit angle, ground/air status and floor normal, and sets facing_dir from xCCC_incDamageDirection. These operations occur even without a registered callback or Ground context. When yaku.x18 and yaku.x10 are both non-null, the handler synchronously forwards the item, Ground context, local vector address, xCEC_fighterGObj and opaque f32 xCA0 value. The vector address is temporary and must not be retained beyond the call. The handler returns false.
facts.rationale: Adds the canonical helper's otherwise omitted item mutation, distinguishes its ignored result from the valid output vector, and documents the cross-callback lifetime boundary without inventing a meaning for xCA0.

evidence.why: Shows operation order, local vector, ignored helper result, guarded callback arguments and false return.
Shows angle handling, vector computation on every branch and unconditional facing_dir assignment.
